title: Takeoff Ground Run Distance
conditions: Wing flaps 15°, paved/level/dry runway, full throttle and max RPM, takeoff speed = 80 MPH IAS

exampleCheck.note: Worked example printed on the chart (points A-F). Re-measured directly from reference/fig5-06-takeoff-ground-run.png pixel positions on 2026-10-01 (B=1673 ft, D=1337 ft, F=1127 ft) — the original chartReading of 1100 was close but the 6000 ft altitude curve's t0/t120 (1020/2050) overestimated the slope by roughly 2x versus the measured 4.4 ft/°F; weightExponent and windKPerMph were refit from the directly-measured B/D/F points.

unverifiedAltitudes.note: The 0/2000/4000/8000 ft altitudeCurves entries below are the ORIGINAL, unverified digitization. Only the 6000 ft entry (above) and the weight/wind exponents have been independently re-measured pixel-by-pixel against the source chart. A reliable automated trace of the other four curves was not achieved in this pass — they cross near a steep 'STD TEMP' reference line on the chart that repeatedly caused the curve-tracer to jump between curves, and disambiguating each one visually would need more time than this pass allowed. Given the 6000 ft entry was off by ~2x, these others likely carry similar error and should be re-checked before being trusted for altitudes other than 6000 ft.
